messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for /v1/generate across multiple regions. 5xx spike concentrated in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Symptoms: user requests hitting deprecated model variant (rv1-small) in some edges -> model mismatch errors. Severity: P1. Paging @sre-oncall and @platform.

eve-sre: ACK. I'm on it. Pulling routing logs and DNS records now.

alice-eng: seeing lots of 502/503s at the edge with this pattern in logs: `model_variant=rv1-small not compatible with schema v2`

ben-netops: quick note: our GSLB had a recent canary rollout to shorten TTLs in eu-west to 30s, but we also pushed an updated edge RRset for rv1-small a few hours ago. Could be a propagation divergence.

carla-platform: canary flags: `smart-routing.policy=region_prefer, fallback=variant_compat` - I rolled a change yesterday that maps certain subnets to rv1-small for cost tests. Rolling that back now.

maria-support: receiving customer tickets: "responses truncated, inconsistent behavior between users in same org" — ~8 customers flagged (EU). Marking customer-impacting.

eve-sre: timeline: request flow shows client -> edge (cdn) -> GSLB -> origin. Edges are returning stale CNAMEs for a subset of pop nodes in eu-west-1 pointing to instances serving rv1-small. Those instances were decommissioned last week but DNS RRsets weren't fully flushed.

dan-pprod: Confirmed. I see old endpoints in the zone: `api-eu-legacy.redwood-internal.net` still present in some NS responses. Example: `dig +short api.redwood.ai @ns1.eu-provider  -> api-eu-legacy.redwood-internal.net` for some queries.

eve-sre: Immediate mitigation plan:
1) Pause smart-routing canary (carla) -> force routing-policy to prefer primary model-hosting pool.
2) Purge edge DNS cache / CDN CNAMEs for affected POPs via provider API.
3) Add short-term NGINX upstream rewrite to drop requests that would hit rv1-small mapping.
4) Notify customers and open postmortem.

carla-platform: pausing canary now: `PATCH /platform/config/smart-routing {"policy":"region_strict","canary":false}` -> patch applied. Confirming listeners updated.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T14:02:03Z: platform-config-v4 -> success (carla-platform).

ben-netops: running DNS cache purge for eu provider. Command used:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.eudns.example.com/v1/purge" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROV_TOKEN" -d '{"zone":"redwood.ai","records":["api.redwood.ai"],"regions":["eu-west-1"]}'
```
Purge acked but propagation to POP caches takes some time (provider shows queued -> pushing -> success).

dan-pprod: Added temporary nginx rule on api-eu-primary to rewrite Host header to `api.redwood.ai` and drop upstream entries pointing to legacy hosts. Patch applied to all eu-west nodes.

eve-sre: after purge and routing-policy pause, error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in ~4 minutes for eu-west-1. ap-south-1 still has elevated errors due to cached negative entries at a local CDN POP; ben is working it.

maria-support: sending interim status to affected customers: "We identified routing to an old model variant caused by stale DNS entries at some edge POPs. We paused the canary and are purging caches. You may see intermittent 5xx for up to 10 minutes. We'll update when fully resolved."

ben-netops: ap-south-1 purge completed, but provider reported a partial failure for 2 POPs due to rate limiting. Retrying with backoff.

alice-eng: logs show a second symptom: some requests were getting directed to the right host but with old header `X-Model-Variant: rv1-small` injected by an older sidecar image on a few hosts. I'm patching sidecar image to reject deprecated headers.

carla-platform: can confirm sidecar rollout to eu-west completed. Also removing the old RRset entries from our zone:```bash
# zone edit
delete RR api-eu-legacy.redwood-internal.net A
save
```
Committed change at 14:09 UTC.

eve-sre: monitoring: SLOs trending back to normal. Current aggregate error rate 0.9% across regions. Marking mitigation as successful but keeping the incident open for full verification and postmortem.

maria-support: sent customer update: "Issue mitigated. We will perform a full postmortem and follow up with root cause and action items."

carla-platform: follow-ups I will own: audit routing-policy release process, add guardrails to prevent mapping canaries to deprecated hostnames, and add automated DNS RRset consistency checks across provider NS responses.

eve-sre: oncall handoff: @eve-sre -> @dan-pprod in 30m. Leaving notes in incident doc: `incident/1791234567/dns-misroute` with timeline + commands used.

deploy-bot: incident-tag: `dns-misroute-1791234567` added to the deploy history.

eve-sre: final: root cause hypothesis: manual RRset removal missed a stale CNAME, combined with a canary smart-routing change that briefly mapped traffic to legacy endpoints. Stale edge DNS caches prolonged the misrouting, causing requests to hit hosts serving a deprecated model variant (rv1-small) which returned schema errors.

carla-platform: will schedule postmortem meeting and assign owners for 72h action items.

maria-support: closing customer-facing thread after postmortem published.

eve-sre: incident status -> mitigated (P1 -> P2), keeping monitor for 2 hours, then close if stable.
